Register_SPI_CONTROL_REGISTER.reg_description: SPI control register used to configure SPI operation, interrupt generation, master mode, clock polarity, clock phase, slave select output, and bit transmission order.

Field.field_description: SPI interrupt enable. Enables SPI interrupt generation when set to 1.
SPI enable. Enables the SPI module when set to 1.
SPI transmit interrupt enable. Enables an interrupt when the SPI transmit buffer is empty.
Master mode select. Selects the SPI module as master when set to 1 and slave when set to 0.
Clock polarity. Determines the idle level of the SPI clock.
Clock phase. Selects the SPI clock edge used for data sampling and shifting.
Slave select output enable. Controls automatic slave select output behavior in master mode.
LSB first enable. Transmits and receives the least significant bit first when set to 1.

Register_SPI_CONTROL_REGISTER2.reg_description: SPI control register used to configure additional SPI operating modes and serial clock prescaling.

Vector_Field.vector_field_description: Serial pre-prescaler control. Selects the input clock division factor before the serial prescaler.

Field.field_description: Mode fault enable. Enables mode fault detection in SPI master mode.
Bidirectional output enable. Enables the SPI data output in bidirectional mode.
SPI stop in wait mode. Controls SPI operation when the system enters wait mode.
Serial pin control. Controls the SPI serial pin configuration.

Register_SPI_BAUD_RATE_REGISTER.reg_description: SPI baud rate register used to configure the serial clock frequency.

Vector_Field.vector_field_description: Serial pre-prescaler control. Selects the division factor of the SPI input clock before the serial prescaler.
Serial prescaler control. Selects the SPI serial clock prescaler value.

Register_SPI_STATUS_REGISTER.reg_description: SPI status register containing flags that indicate transfer completion, transmit buffer status, and mode fault conditions.

Field.field_description: SPI interrupt flag. Indicates that an SPI transfer has completed.
SPI transmit buffer empty flag. Indicates that the SPI transmit buffer is empty and ready for new data.
Mode fault flag. Indicates that a mode fault condition has occurred during SPI operation.

Register_SPI_DATA_REGISTER.reg_description: SPI data register used to store data for transmission and received data.

Vector_Field.vector_field_description: SPI data field. Contains the data to be transmitted or the data received through the SPI interface.

Register_SPI_COMMAND_REGISTER.reg_description: SPI command register used to issue control commands to the SPI module. This register is write-only.

Field.field_description: Start command. Writing 1 starts an SPI transfer.
Clear command. Writing 1 clears the SPI status and control state.
Abort command. Writing 1 aborts the current SPI transfer.
